free_tier.stated: not free. Aggressive first-year prices with a separate renewal price on the same page

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a domain name

retention.stated: a registration runs for its term and renews at the price printed beside the promo

interface_detail: a web dashboard and an API
chaining: the cheapest first year on .com of the three read here, and a renewal close to Cloudflare's

limits.value: the sale price applies to the first year only; the renewal column is the recurring price

confidence_note: the landing page prints both prices for each TLD, so the promo and the renewal are two documented numbers rather than one.

evidence.proved: .com USD 8.88 first year, renew USD 9.98; .net USD 11.20 and renew USD 11.20; .org USD 6.65, renew USD 11.39; .online USD 0.98, renew USD 15.08; .xyz USD 1.86, renew USD 13.77; .io renew USD 51.75; .ai renew USD 79.98; .com carries a USD 0.20 ICANN fee per year

price_per_tb_month: USD 8.88 then USD 9.98 .com; USD 6.65 then USD 11.39 .org; USD 0.98 then USD 15.08 .online
notes: The .online row is the sharpest promo in the set: 0.98 then 15.08, a 15.4 times jump. The .com row is the one worth taking, because 8.88 then 9.98 is cheaper in both years than Cloudflare at 10.46.
